text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ Running with everyone really is so 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And besides, and besides~, I feel like 
I've gotten stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because I managed to keep right up with 
everyone! I think that's huge progress!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because I managed to keep right up with 
everyone! I think that's huge progress!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! I feel like I can 
definitely get 1st place next time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta practice for interviews while 
we still have time! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it together later~! I'll play the 
announcer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's practice lots so we don't get 
nervous~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You scared me! ...W-What's the 
matter?
choice_data_list: I'm giving you a pep talk!
I'm just trying to pump you up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! I've seen that on TV. It's that thing 
where you cheer them on with 'Do your 
best!'

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll try even, even harder! Trying 
hard is what I'm best at, after all♪
